questions.question: Please identify the page in Nancy Marie Brown’s The Abacus and the Cross for the line about a magician, a king and a mathematician. The publisher confirms the 2012 edition at https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/nancy-marie-brown/the-abacus-and-the-cross/9780465031443/, but the exact line has not yet been checked against the book. Please agree a source or a note describing it as a joke.

questions.question: The cover shows a bead frame with counters on rods, whereas Gerbert’s abacus was a place-value counting board with movable counters. State in both captions that the illustration is schematic. Evidence: https://www.sciamvs.org/files/SCIAMVS_03_091-108_Burnett.pdf, pp. 91–92.
